preserved_product_invariants: User assertions/corroboration/model suggestions/retrieved law/applicable requirements/conditional IR/actual proofs/human reviews remain separate roles.
Legal authority requires admitted source, exact edition/version/hash/byte span and explicit applicability/context; retrieval confidence and user text do not govern law.
Human review and proof compilation do not create court-filing or legal-sufficiency claims.
Operational admin role is not private case-content/key access; granted lawyer context is independent.
Intentional human waits and finite unresolved outcomes are legitimate; they do not restart development supervision or become false completion.
No automatic user complaint egress from choosing Grok4.7 for code-generation campaign.
Local CID/cache is not network durability; only measured encrypted replica/readback observations count.
Original completed60 campaign and its identities/counters/ledgers remain immutable; new CIMP-UX campaign uses its own state/task IDs.
